sentences.en: In chemistry class, we use the Bunsen burner to heat up test tubes.
sentences.zh: 在化学课上，我们用本生灯加热试管。

sentences.en: The teacher showed us how to adjust the flame on a Bunsen burner.
sentences.zh: 老师向我们展示了如何调节本生灯的火焰大小。

sentences.en: Be careful with the Bunsen burner; it can get very hot!
sentences.zh: 小心使用本生灯，它会变得非常烫！
